deployment.priorAttempt: temporary-filesystem-full-before-upload; identical candidate retried on main filesystem

method.navigation: in-page DOM activation of existing navigation anchors; actual Next router and root RSC fetch
method.clock: browser-performance-now; all browser offsets relative to anchor activation; Worker spans use independent request-relative clock
method.rscEofDefinition: ResourceTiming.responseEnd relative to anchor activation, supported by bounded clone drain
method.visibilityDefinition: matching fixed route heading and route-specific completed-content selector visible
method.twoFramesDefinition: two animation frames after completed-content visibility
method.settledDefinition: completed content plus root EOF plus two frames plus 100ms without observed main mutations
method.resourceMonitoring: current navigation same-origin resource counts only; no resource names retained
method.reader: bounded 4MiB clone; chunks discarded without decoding; real response returned immediately
method.headerSnapshot: initial allowlisted PERF4 duration entries only; platform-added entries and all descriptions excluded
method.warmupNote: First Home warmup strict header filter rejected the combined platform header. Filter narrowed to fixed PERF4 entries before other warmups and all retained samples. No navigation repeated.

analytics.retrieval: read-only SQL API through existing authenticated Cloudflare dashboard; only retained opaque IDs queried

privacy.limitations: fixed SQL API columns are padded; original submitted array lengths are established by source schema, unused columns verified empty or zero; platform storage metadata is separate

auth.remoteRevocation: deployed remote revocation remains unproven; local active-workerd revocation passed

historicalComparison.qualification: directional comparison only: same 100ms settle guard and completed-route criterion; original full capture code and exact network clock origin unavailable. No controlled instrumentation overhead or improvement/regression claim.

analysis.dominant: serial native D1 invocation wall waits
analysis.home: three sequential waits; identity includes wait1; inclusive home contains wait2 and wait3; median total586ms
analysis.systems: three sequential waits; identity includes wait1; inclusive systems contains wait2 and wait3; median total550ms
analysis.waterfall: one root RSC and one same-origin resource in every retained sample; no follow-up client data waterfall observed
analysis.clockLimitation: deployed Workers performance.now advances after I/O; zero response/first/actor/unattributed does not prove zero CPU, render, or scheduling cost
analysis.safeHypothesis: Reduce per-invocation Worker-to-D1 wait cost; a separately authorized controlled placement/transport experiment is a narrow hypothesis. Ordinals cannot identify SQL or prove placement is the cause.
